# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b48 - Alert about open windows when everyone leaves

## New opt-in Home notification

Enable **Alert when windows remain open after everyone leaves** on the Home Environment Manager's Home device or in General settings. The Manager observes the configured home's Home Assistant `person.*` entities plus selected home tracking sources. It never equates an unknown/offline tracker with being away. Only after everyone is confirmed away and the condition remains true for 60 seconds does it check for open real `binary_sensor.*` Window-class contacts in selected rooms.

The notification lists real window names grouped by their Home Assistant rooms and asks the recipient to close them. Motorized covers, door sensors and not-selected windows are not mistaken for open windows. A trip receives at most one notification for the same windows; newly opened windows while still away can be reported separately. A restart when everybody was already away never triggers an accidental new alert. Returning home rearms the next trip.

The action is informational and NEVER closes/open windows, shades, covers or actuates climate devices.

## Announcement Hub routing: target exact people and channels

When Announcement Hub is installed, General settings offers a Home Assistant `person.*` recipient **multi-select** and a second **delivery multi-select**: phone notification, phone Companion TTS, watch notification, watch Companion TTS, tablet notification, tablet Companion TTS, other notification, other Companion TTS.

Selected people must have the chosen mobile/watch/tablet outputs assigned in **Announcement Hub -> People**. Person-targeted `notify.announcement_hub` jobs use exact selected persons, one mapped device slot at a time, and `occupied_only: false` because their phones are intentionally outside home. Mixing channels never expands recipients: phone text + watch speech produces only phone text + watch speech. No room TTS, Snapcast, all-integration broadcast, generic fallback or recipient inference occurs. If Hub is installed but unavailable, delivery is held/retried without silently switching to household speakers.

If Hub is not installed, eligible configured direct mobile app notification entities can receive a normal native HA notify message; when none is available, the built-in HA persistent notification is the final fallback. This alert does not alter existing room-targeted recommendations or their Hub routing.

## Home, safety and compatibility

Off by default. A configured house tracker with `unavailable` or an unknown Home Assistant Person cannot prove absence. The existing home presence policy and away cooldown are respected, along with a 60-second departure confirmation. Actual Window contacts are checked again immediately before delivery, with an explicit physical-source and room-match filter. Notifications are deduplicated within each absence; delivery failure does not create duplicate local broadcasts.

Retains all beta47 valid-sensor averaging, mold recalibration, beta46 text formatting, and beta45 per-cover controls with their existing permissions. Only canonical `environment_manager` is shipped. Old prerelease tags and stable v0.5.1 remain untouched. Existing installations stay opted-out until enabled.

## Installation

In Home Assistant HACS, choose Home Environment Manager -> Redownload / version selection -> Show beta versions -> **v0.6.0b48**, then restart Home Assistant.

Configure real Home Assistant person/tracker sources in General settings first. When Hub is installed, select recipients and delivery channels, and configure their named destination devices in Announcement Hub's person profiles. Enable the new switch and test by leaving home with one selected physical window open.

## Automated gates

Requires full Python 3.13/3.14 tests, including new departure/unknown/multi-person, window selection and exact person-target routing regressions; 38 translated catalogs and generated text; frontend Node; real HA2026.10 registry/room tests; HACS/hassfest; exact flat HACS archive simulation; and immutable beta release publication only after all gates succeed.
